recommendation: Keep this FHIR-53412 cleanup as-is. Handle FHIR-54058, FHIR-54062, and FHIR-54252 separately when resolved-change-required issues are in scope, because they require broader work on the offset constraints, Timing example table, and cyclic dosage modeling.
issue_request: FHIR-53412 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 FHIR-I request to add Timing.repeat.startOffset and Timing.repeat.endOffset and clarify how repeat-window timing relates to Timing.repeat.when. The final disposition narrowed the original four-element proposal to the two offset elements and explicitly left startEvent/endEvent outside Timing.
initial_application: Commit ba10a6f24d181dec80b69dd90e68e0337421e7a0 added the startOffset and endOffset rows to source/datatypes/timing.xml, added Timing narrative in source/datatypes.html, and added dosage examples. The application included the requested elements and constraints, but left endOffset text saying events would "step" rather than "stop", a broken <cod> tag around count in the new Timing narrative, and a dosage example that still called startOffset an extension.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Timing and Dosage as active normative datatypes, so the edited datatype and dosage source files feed the current build. FHIR-I 2025-11-10 minutes confirm the FHIR-53412 motion and the decision not to include startEvent/endEvent. Later FHIR-54058 and FHIR-54062 are Resolved - change required, not Applied/Published, and cover broader Timing example-table and constraint changes; FHIR-54252 raises a larger Pharmacy dosage-cycle modeling concern. Those issues were treated as related context rather than decided here.
reconciliation: Published a non-empty source commit that changes only bounded seed-scope strings: endOffset short/definition wording now says repeat-period events stop before the end of the period, the Timing narrative uses count, and the dosage example identifies Timing.repeat.startOffset as a core element rather than an extension.
source_changes: source/datatypes/timing.xml: corrected endOffset short definition and definition from "step" wording to "stop" wording.
source/datatypes.html: corrected the new Timing repeat-window paragraph to use a valid count tag.
source/dosage-examples.html: corrected the Day-8 example to call Timing.repeat.startOffset an element rather than an extension.
